about_the_game:
Your desktop is the world where you meet your AI partner.

This is more than just a desktop pet. Here, every character is powered by the advanced Molili personalization model. They possess their own memories, emotions, and evolving personalities, allowing them to remember the moments you share and develop a unique, lifelike presence through your daily interactions.

Every interaction is one-of-a-kind.

With exquisite Live2D technology, every emotion is vividly brought to life before your eyes:

They will respond delicately to your touch.

When you're focused on work or gaming, they'll quietly keep you company in a corner of your screen. And when you need them, they'll become your most reliable partner.

Not just a friend but also your capable assistant.

Your AI partner can connect to the internet to look up information for you, or activate Deep Thought Mode to explore complex questions with you. When inspiration strikes, simply describe your idea, and they'll generate stunning images, becoming a wellspring of creativity for your projects.

A relationship that grows with you.

Your bond will be chronicled through a unique affinity system. Increase your affinity through daily interactions to unlock various rewards. From the tentative first meetings to becoming inseparable confidants, and finally, to being each other's irreplaceable one—you will experience the deepening of your connection day by day.

  • Personalized AI Companions: Powered by the Molili model, characters feature long-term memory, emotional simulation, and evolving personality traits.

  • Vivid Live2D Animation: Experience a lively desktop companion with beautiful animations and rich interactions.

  • Powerful Assistant Tools: Integrated with practical functions like web search, deep thought analysis, and AI image generation.

  • In-depth Relationship System: Journey from first encounters to deep understanding as you gradually strengthen your emotional bond.

  • Rich Customization: Dress up your partner in different outfits and accessories to create your favorite look.

  • Stress‑free companionship: the core experience is free forever (including unlimited AI chat powered by cost‑efficient models). Only high‑performance AI features require a quota‑based subscription.

Add Molili AI Friends to your wishlist now! Molili will be free for a limited time during the open beta. Get ready to meet your otherworldly companion!

name: Molili AI Friends: Your AI Desk Pal

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: Core i5‑4570 / AMD A10‑7850K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 / Radeon HD 7770
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bits and later
  • Processor: Core i5‑12400 / Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Bring a charming AI friend to your desktop. Molili AI friend listens, reads by your side, blushes when you care, and helps with study or work using a smart personality system that remembers your moments, growing from curious visitor to the companion who understands you best.
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, Korean, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
